_comment: Decision spaces scored by scripts/langid/score.py from a single run.py sweep.
Codes are VoxLingua107 label codes; `aliases` maps the spellings a caller
is likely to use onto them (the same aliases the GGUF carries).
handy40 IS A PLACEHOLDER. The real Handy language list
was not available when this was written, so it is a plausible 40-language
dictation set: the 15 evaluated languages plus 25 widely-dictated ones.
Replace `handy40.codes` with the real list and re-run score.py; nothing
else has to change, because run.py stores all 107 logits per utterance.
The 11 pair/triple selections are langid.cpp's original evaluation table,
with `nb+da` written `no+da`: VoxLingua107 spells Norwegian Bokmal `no`.
